Ready for the maintainer to merge.

I read the refreshed head `f3c19705e` and the delta after `25733acf3`. I verified the four earlier findings. The PR is still a draft; a maintainer flags it ready and merges by hand.

## What looks good

- Both P1 findings are fixed by the merged parent #3472:
  - The kerf side law reads the chuck alone (`crates/motion/src/turning/parting_law.rs:41`) and the verdict reads that side, not the generator's choice (`parting_law.rs:133`). The pin `turning_part_kerf::a_front_facing_allowance_never_turns_the_kerf_into_the_part` is present.
  - The Part stamp carries the salt `part-off-kerf-side-v1` (`crates/app/src/operation/stamp.rs:147`). The regression `a_part_off_saved_before_3452_loads_stale_and_does_not_post` loads the pre-#3452 fixture, reads `Stale`, and refuses the post.
- The spot cone judges at the finished part top. The plain context sets `rim_top_z` only for `Drill` (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:3602`); the framed context keeps `None` (`generate.rs:4001`). Rapid and collision checks keep the stock top.
- Bounds are safe. A nonfinite `rim_top_z` and a lateral or arc feed fall back to the nominal cutter radius (`crates/sim/src/verify/section/radius.rs:34`, `radius.rs:38-44`). A spot that cuts the finished wall still gouges.
- The conflict in `crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs` took main's stricter form. That file is byte-identical to `origin/main` on this head, and the assertion checks `G01 X0. Z12. F0.02`.
- No golden, catalog file or snapshot PNG changes. The decision record `docs/decisions/3451-spot-drill-part-top.md` is present and in the required format.

## Results merged with main

Locally, my own worktree, `CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=3`. The first trial merge with `origin/main` (`8c6b77f94`) was clean. The suites ran on that merged tree:

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-sim spot_drill_radius` | 11 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app spot_drill_verify` | 4 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app part_off_saved_before_3452` | 2 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-motion turning_part_kerf` | 6 passed, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-app example_catalog::turning_cone_thread_case_posts_the_taper_and_the_thread` | 1 passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 3 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

`origin/main` moved to `44c13a01d` during the review. I re-merged it into the trial tree: clean, no conflicts. Its delta is `crates/sim/src/stock_sim/preview/march.rs`, `crates/sim/tests/stock_preview.rs`, `crates/ui/src/trace.wgsl` and a decision record. It does not touch the verify, generate, parting or stamp code of this PR. I re-ran the named pins on that newest merged tree with `cargo xtask gate test`:

| Pin | Result |
|---|---|
| `spot_drill_radius::extra_stock_above_the_part_does_not_enlarge_the_spot_footprint` | passed |
| `spot_drill_verify::spot_cone_below_extra_stock_clears_the_part_and_posts` | passed |
| `part_off_saved_before_3452::a_part_off_saved_before_3452_loads_stale_and_does_not_post` | passed |
| `turning_part_kerf::a_front_facing_allowance_never_turns_the_kerf_into_the_part` | passed |
| `example_catalog::turning_cone_thread_case_posts_the_taper_and_the_thread` | passed |

## Targeted tests

- Example catalog: the cone-thread case passes (above). This PR changes no post or toolpath output; its only catalog file was the conflict resolved to main's text.
- Light lane `cargo xtask gate light`: 3 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. The two light twins are motion adaptive-trochoidal tests; none covers the touched verify or generate code.
- Heavy lanes: none. This is a `P3` PR, so no targeted heavy step applies (#3556).

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` is already over 400 lines; this PR adds 3 lines.
- The PR stays a draft. That is the author's state; a maintainer handles the ready flag and the merge.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
